/**
 * @typedef {'red'|'blue'|'green'|'white'|'yellow'|'purple'} BspoColor
 * @typedef {{ lv: 1|2|3|4|5, core: number, bp: number }} LevelInfo
 *
 * @typedef {Object} Card
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} name
 * @property {number} cost
 * @property {Record<BspoColor, number>} reduction
 * @property {BspoColor} color
 * @property {number} symbolCount
 * @property {BspoColor} symbolColor
 * @property {LevelInfo[]} levels
 * @property {'spirit'|'nexus'|'magic'} type
 * @property {string} img
 */

export const cards = [
  // ======== Spirits ========
  {
    id: 'blade-001',
    name: 'ブレイド',
    cost: 0,
    reduction: { red: 0, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 1000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 2, bp: 2000 },
      { lv: 3, core: 3, bp: 3000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/bureido.jpeg',
  },
  {
    id: 'draguron-001',
    name: 'ドラグロン',
    cost: 2,
    reduction: { red: 2, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    // ★アタック中のみ、Lv1/2ならBP+2000（ルールはBattle.jsx側のgetAttackBPで実装）
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 1000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 2, bp: 3000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/doraguron.jpeg',
  },
  {
    id: 'siegwurm-001',
    name: '雷皇竜ジークヴルム',
    cost: 6,
    reduction: { red: 3, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    // ★アタック時 強制ブロック（相手に回復スピリットがいれば必ずブロック）：Battle.jsx側で実装
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 4000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 3, bp: 6000 },
      { lv: 3, core: 5, bp: 9000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/raimei-ryu-zi-gurimu.webp',
  },
  {
    id: 'lizardgee-001',
    name: 'リザドエッジ',
    cost: 0,
    reduction: { red: 0, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 1000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 2, bp: 2000 },
      { lv: 3, core: 4, bp: 4000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/rizadoejji.jpeg',
  },
  {
    id: 'rokukera-001',
    name: 'ロクケラトプス',
    cost: 1,
    reduction: { red: 1, blue: 0, green: 2, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 1000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 2, bp: 3000 },
      { lv: 3, core: 3, bp: 4000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/rokukeratopsu.jpeg',
  },
  {
    id: 'sthira-001',
    name: 'スチラホン',
    cost: 5,
    reduction: { red: 4, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 1, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'red',
    levels: [
      { lv: 1, core: 1, bp: 3000 },
      { lv: 2, core: 3, bp: 5000 },
      { lv: 3, core: 4, bp: 8000 },
    ],
    type: 'spirit',
    img: '/images/suthiraho-nn.jpeg',
  },

  {
    id: 'art_siegwurm-001',
    name: 'アルティメットジークヴルム',
    cost: 8,
    reduction: { red: 4, blue: 0, green: 0, white: 0, yellow: 0, purple: 0 },
    color: 'red',
    symbolCount: 1,
    symbolColor: 'arutimetto',
    levels: [
      { lv: 3, core: 1, bp: 15000 },
      { lv: 4, core: 3, bp: 20000 },
      { lv: 5, core: 5, bp: 30000 },
    ],
    type: 'arutimetto',
    img: '/images/art_j.jpeg',
  },
  
];
